senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; preced.) chain, rope for fastening the yoke of the animal to the plough (Maim.); [the pole tied to the yoke by means of a knotted rope (R. S.)].
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 21:2">Kel. XXI, 2</cite>. Sifra Shʾmini, Par. 6, ch. VIII.—

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 99b:6">Snh. 99ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Isaiah 5:18">Is. V, 18</cite>) <he>בתחלה … לע׳ העגלה</he> at first the evil inclination resembles a thread of cobweb, and at the end it is like a wagon rope; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 129">Yalk. Gen. 129</cite>.—Pl. <he>עֲבוֹתוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Sukkah 52a">Succ. 52ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 270">Yalk. Is. 270</cite> (not <he>עבותי׳</he>).—V. <cite ref="P00055"><he>עָבִית</he></cite>.
